public_private_data_policy.public: Public conformance uses checked-in public release, source, schema, SDK, and synthetic negative fixtures only.
public_private_data_policy.private: Private source archives, client artifacts, and research-only future-BS exact vectors are excluded.
public_private_data_policy.authority_boundary: Self-reported compatibility is not external certification or official calendar authority.
